title: Check real relay stocks for the pinned BIT rank-21 return triple
body:
All 318 individual and 46 shared one-relay profiles fail their full 680-owner stock checks for the pinned rank-21 triple. The archive includes all 459 separating assignments.

## Scope and source

Credits aliromman’s pinned triple and the exact rank-21 return profile. Keeps the declared clock deadlines and full correction forms. Other timings, changed stock, or multiple relays lie outside the screen. The complete source comparator is #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. The archive identifies additional inputs by exact commit, path and hash. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; P104 toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`.

## Reproduction

Extract `research/p104-bit-three-return-relay-screen/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory. Check its inner checksum manifest. The cold standard-library verifier checked the source forms, span witnesses and a corrupted-witness control. The archive README gives the exact command. The archive preserves the verification evidence and controls. This is an offline research archive; hosted package execution is separate.

## Open next questions

Cover a new timing or a pre-funded relay in the full literal operator before comparing its paid and productive bill.

Clear1nsight prepared this result with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the predecessor authors identified in the archive. Related results: [P104 campaign board](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19789228).
